entries.subject: DAMIT 1815: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: DAMIT model 1815, version 2017-06-19, pole (287°, 25°), period 9.76503 h, taken unchanged from the archive.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: 168 ± 5 km, volume-equivalent diameter of the archived ADAM model. DAMIT marks model 1815 as size-calibrated (D = 168 km, σ = 5 km), the volume-equivalent diameter of this ADAM solution. Hanuš et al. (2017) Table 4 lists 167 ± 5 km for the publication fit; the archived release is kept as archived. The fit used 83 light curves, 1 adaptive-optics image and 2 occultations (Table 3).
